title: Export button does nothing on Safari
body: On Safari 17.5 the Export button on the orders screen does nothing. No file downloads and no error appears. The same button works in Chrome.

comments.body: Reproduced on Safari 17.5 on macOS. Chrome downloads the PDF fine.
My guess is the backend rejecting the Safari user agent. Let us check the API first.
The export request comes back 200 with the PDF body, so the server is fine. HAR capture from the failing Safari session: https://github.com/user-attachments/files/900123/export-capture.har
